faq.q: Does every FHA loan have a partial claim?
faq.a: Do not assume one exists solely because the loan is FHA-insured. Ask your servicer and closing team to review your actual assistance and loan documents.

faq.q: Is an FHA partial claim the same as mortgage forgiveness?
faq.a: HUD describes the standalone partial claim as an interest-free subordinate lien with repayment triggers, including a sale. Review the actual obligation instead of assuming it was forgiven.

faq.q: Can I estimate sale proceeds from my first-mortgage statement alone?
faq.a: Not reliably when a separate obligation may exist. Have the closing team reconcile all required payoffs and confirm which amounts are already included.

faq.q: Can Cash As-Is evaluate my house while the payoff is being checked?
faq.a: Yes. Explain the assistance arrangement when requesting a property review. An evaluation does not cancel debt, establish relief eligibility or guarantee a closing date.

substantiveDifference: Standalone FHA loss-mitigation subordinate debt, its separate payoff and seller-net arithmetic; not HECM rules, disputed liens or a loan already paid off.
